title: Creative Merge Rejected Details
description: Typed details for CREATIVE_MERGE_REJECTED. Lists every merge assignment operation the seller rejected in the request, with a reason, so the buyer can correct or drop those merges and resubmit the rest in one request.

operation_index.description: Zero-based index of the rejected operation in the request's assignment_operations array.

package_id.description: Package of the rejected merge. For a library-level merge, present only when one current assignment blocks the merge: one entry names each blocking package.
